description: Eawag provides a preprocessed subset of floodX measurements selected for urban flood-monitoring research. The public ZIP contains site-scale text-based observations from the Wangen testbed in Switzerland, while videos and photographs are deposited separately. The provider distinguishes this monitoring subset from the calibration subset, so the two should not be assumed to contain identical experiments or quality selections. Zenodo supplies the monitoring data free under CC0-1.0. Experiment dates, sampling intervals and retained sensor counts require the accompanying package documentation and were not established from the summary. The provider warns that two radar-velocity series have systematic errors of up to 50 percent and that their absolute values must be disregarded. Subject to those limitations, the data can calibrate observation-processing and urban flood-state estimation in hydraulic simulations. They complement the raw floodX archive and visual observations with prepared monitoring series. The review did not download readings or reproduce the preprocessing.
